outcome.reason: Customer mentioned legal action and involvement of lawyer and ombudsman.

transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Yes, this is Rakesh Sharma speaking. What can I help you with?

Thank you for confirming, Mr. Sharma.

I'm calling to remind you that your Mumbai Bank credit card payment of Rs 4,820 was due on 2026-10-15. As of today, the payment is still pending.

To avoid further interest of 3.5% per month and a late fee of Rs 750 if your outstanding balance is above Rs 10,000, may I know when you will be able to make at least the minimum payment?

My lawyer has advised me not to make any payment right now. I'm actually filing a complaint with the banking ombudsman regarding this matter. Can you tell me if the bank intends to take me to court over this? A simple yes or no will do.
